nodes.name: Fe spiking by cycling
nodes.procedure: The second step was the preparation of FSN by cycling 50 times in a Fe precursor (1 mM) containing the KOH electrolyte (1.0 M). Fe spiking on the Ni(OH)₂ substrate resulted in FeOOH phase, where Fe was inserted into the Ni lattice.

nodes.name: TPP spray-coating
nodes.procedure: The final step was TPP loading on the electrodeposited FSN electrode by spray-coating. TPP ink (0.1 mM TPP in acetonitrile/tetrahydrofuran) was sprayed onto the FSN over CP (TPP-FSN). The optimal amount of TPP loaded (2 mL cm⁻²) on FSN was employed.

nodes.description: CV activity and stability tests in half-cell (general conditions: three-electrode, graphite rod CE, RHE RE, 1.0 M Fe-purified KOH)
nodes.source_text: All electrochemical measurements were performed in a polymer-based electrochemical cell... A graphite rod counter electrode was used... The reference electrode was calibrated using an RHE... In the first CV, FSN and TPP-FSN exhibited similar activity (352 mV@30 mA cm⁻²)... The FSN overpotential increased from 352 to 374 mV... The Tafel slope of FSN increased to 64 mV dec⁻¹ (ΔFSN = 13 mV dec⁻¹)... The changes in charge transfer resistance (ΔR_CT) for FSN... were 0.96 Ω.

nodes.description: CV activity and stability tests in half-cell (general conditions: three-electrode, graphite rod CE, RHE RE, 1.0 M Fe-purified KOH)
nodes.source_text: All electrochemical measurements were performed in a polymer-based electrochemical cell... A graphite rod counter electrode was used... The reference electrode was calibrated using an RHE... the TPP-FSN overpotential increased from 352 to 362 mV... TPP-FSN Tafel slope increment decreased by six times (ΔTPP-FSN = 2 mV dec⁻¹)... The changes in charge transfer resistance (ΔR_CT) for FSN and TPP-FSN... were 0.96 and 0.29 Ω respectively.

nodes.description: AEMWE full cell chronopotentiometry (catalyst-coated-membrane method, Pt/C cathode, commercial AEM)
nodes.source_text: The MEA was prepared by the catalyst-coated-membrane method using a commercial Pt/C (cathode) on a commercial AEM... The experiments were performed at 60°C in KOH (1.0 M) and MEA (9 cm²)... Chronopotentiometry measurement was conducted at 500 mA cm⁻² for 115 h at a 1.41 mV h⁻¹ degradation rate, which was lower than the degradation rate during the first 25 h (1.56 mV h⁻¹)... a 126 L h⁻¹ H₂ flow rate and 62 L h⁻¹ O₂ flow rate showed a 91% faradaic efficiency.

nodes.characterization_summary: FSN shows Fe:Ni ratio of 2:8 (20 wt% Fe) in bulk.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning electron microscopy with energy dispersive spectroscopy (SEM-EDS) indicated that the resulting FSN had an Fe:Ni ratio of 2:8...

nodes.characterization_summary: FSN surface Fe:Ni = 4:6 (most Fe on surface); TPP-FSN shows N 1s at 400 eV (square planar N ring) with N content 1%→3%; structure stable at EOT.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Surface-sensitive Xray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) revealed an Fe:Ni ratio of 4:6, which indicated that most Fe was placed on the surface... High-resolution XPS N 1s profiles of FSN (BOT), TPP-FSN (BOT), and TPP-FSN (EOT). The binding energy of 400 eV emerged when TPP was loaded... When TPP was loaded onto the FSN, the nitrogen content changed from 1% to 3%.

nodes.characterization_summary: FSN shows FeOOH phase (526 and 690 cm⁻¹) and NiOOH (480 and 560 cm⁻¹); TPP signature swamps FSN signals confirming coverage.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NiOOH (480 and 560 cm⁻¹) and FeOOH (526 and 690 cm⁻¹) species in the as-synthesized FSN were detected by Raman spectroscopy...

nodes.characterization_summary: Cdl increases confirm TPP loading: CP (18 μF cm⁻²) → FSN/CP (49 μF cm⁻²) → TPP-FSN (257 μF cm⁻²).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The double-layer capacitance (Cdl) changed... The FSN electrodeposition on the CP increased from 18 to 49 μF cm⁻², while the TPP loading on the FSN increased from 49 to 257 μF cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrodeposited Ni(OH)₂ shows spherical morphology; TPP loading creates homogeneous porous layer on FSN.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Electrodeposited Ni(OH)₂ showed a spherical morphology on the carbon fibers (Figures S1a and b)... SEM visualized the change in morphology after TPP loading...

nodes.characterization_summary: FSN and TPP-FSN at BOT show FeOOH-like singlet pre-edge at 7114 eV; EOT shows doublet peaks indicating FeO/Fe₂O₃ redeposition, no Fe-TPP coordination.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) at the Fe K-edge... Both FSN and TPP-FSN at BOT had a singlet pre-edge peak at 7114 eV, resembling that of FeOOH...

nodes.characterization_summary: FSN and TPP-FSN show minimal ¹⁸O labeling (7 cm⁻¹ red-shift) sustained in ¹⁶OH⁻ confirming AEM mechanism unlike pure Ni (LOM with 25 cm⁻¹ shift).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectra of c) Ni, d) FSN, and e) TPP-FSN. ¹⁸O-labeling was conducted in K¹⁸OH (1 M)... no dramatic ¹⁸O labeling was observed since their peak was only 7 cm⁻¹ redshifted.
